Legacy of RexxarPassive
Instant
Critical strikes with Primal Shred grant you and your pet Misha's Rage for 12 sec, causing auto attacks to deal an additional 85+AP*0.125 Physical damage.

Critical strikes with Rylak's Bite grant you and your pet Leokk's Fury, increasing melee haste by 2% for 12 sec, stacking 3 times.

Critical strikes with Wildclaw grant you and your pet Huffer's Speed, increasing movement speed by 8% for 12 sec, stacking 3 times.
